blocks.text: A temporary steel bridge connecting the damaged sections of the Agana Bridge in Tarlac City could be opened to light vehicles within two weeks, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said Wednesday as he personally inspected ongoing repair works by the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
